# Meet LYGG at Offshore Energy26 in Amsterdam


Jaa artikkeli:


06.11.2026


News


**LYGG is heading to Offshore Energy (OEEC2026) on 24–25 November in Amsterdam. Meet our team at the East of England Pavilion, Stand 2.224, and join us on stage on Wednesday to hear real-life cases of how companies can solve regional connectivity challenges together.**


Connecting the North Sea starts with connecting people.


Our Founder Roope Kekäläinen, CCO Katja Vainio and Growth Manager Maria Hamminga will be attending OEEC to meet companies, partners and industry professionals interested in making regional business travel more efficient.


At LYGG, we work directly with companies to understand their travel needs, bring demand together and create air connections that would otherwise not exist. Whether through regional flight connections or tailored flight solutions, the goal is the same: making business travel work better for companies and their people.


## Stop buying tickets, start booking connections


**Wednesday, 25 November | 10:30–10:55**


What happens when existing travel options no longer meet business needs?


On Wednesday, LYGG Founder Roope Kekäläinen will take the stage together with our clients **Kees-Jan van Engelenburg from Vestas** and **Jean Michel Rijken from Clarksons Port Services** to share real-life cases of how better connections make a difference for businesses.


The session explores how companies can solve connectivity challenges together by transforming identified travel demand into new air mobility solutions.


As Roope puts it:


> “This is not only about aviation. It’s about what we can achieve when companies stop solving the same connectivity challenge individually and start solving it together.”


## Come and meet us!


Are you looking for better connections across the North Sea? We’d love to hear about your company’s travel needs and explore what we could achieve together.


**24–25 November 2026**


**East of England Pavilion | Stand 2.224**


See you in Amsterdam!
